label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: E hizo dos querubines de oro; de martillo hizo a ellos desde los dos extremos de la kappóret.
spanish: E hizo dos querubines de oro; labrados hizo a ellos desde los dos extremos del propiciatorio.
grammarChanges: Replaced "de martillo", which names the hammering tool and adds a preposition not licensed by מִקְשָׁה, with "labrados" (hammered/beaten work), the licensed sense of the feminine singular noun.

Replaced the untranslated transliteration "kappóret" with the common-noun translation "propiciatorio" (the token is a feminine noun with the definite article, not a proper name), adjusting the article to "del propiciatorio" for Spanish gender agreement.
readerNote: Chose the plural "labrados" to agree with the two cherubim (the plural object) rather than keeping מִקְשָׁה's singular Hebrew form, since singular and plural agreement could not both be kept.
